summary.text: Margie Bright Matthews is a Democratic member of the South Carolina Senate for District 45, which covers Beaufort, Charleston, Colleton, Hampton and Jasper Counties.
She was elected in a special election on October 20, 2015, to fill the unexpired term of Clementa C. Pinckney, who died.

paragraphs.text: Bright Matthews was born and raised in Walterboro, and her official page lists a B.S. and a J.D. from the University of South Carolina.
She has been an attorney and owner of Bright Matthews Law Firm, LLC since 1992.
She was elected to the Senate in a special election on October 20, 2015.
Her page lists the 2023 John F. Kennedy Profiles in Courage Award.
Her committees are Ethics, Finance, Labor, Commerce and Industry, Legislative Oversight, Medical Affairs and Transportation.
